verdict.rationale: Better Stack's incident management can automatically post a to-do list when a new incident is triggered and route it to the right responder (betterstack-docs-59), which is a thin runbook-like checklist attached to incidents. Its AI SRE investigates incidents using telemetry (betterstack-docs-23) but never takes automated actions without approval (betterstack-docs-70), so diagnostics are assisted rather than triggered runbook steps. missing for 10: a documented runbook object attached to incidents, automatic incident-channel creation, automated task assignment as runbook steps, automatically triggered diagnostic actions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
